verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference API platform, so bringing your own weights is a fair question. The pack shows no way to upload custom model weights or LoRA adapters. Dedicated endpoints only reserve capacity for a model Morph offers ('choosing a model and plan'), and custom Reflexes train small classifiers from labeled examples, which is an adjacent feature rather than serving user-supplied weights.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters
